This ''' individual''' was the publicist of [[Ledina Chott]], a famous pop [[Musician/Legends|singer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. The publicist insisted that the walls of the social room in Chott's house in [[Tiara Ridge estates]] feature [[Hologram/Legends|holos]] of Chott's concerts so that visitors would be reminded of nothing but the singer, despite Chott preferring to feature singers and [[Actor/Legends|actors]] that she liked.<ref name="MK" />
